summary_en: AFC-HD Amus Life Science will acquire Saikaya Department Store through a stock exchange, making Saikaya a wholly owned subsidiary effective December 15, 2026. Saikaya shares will delist from the Tokyo Stock Exchange on December 11, 2026. The exchange ratio was determined based on independent valuation considering Saikaya's earnings, financial position, real estate assets, and market price.
title_en: Notice Regarding Execution of Stock Exchange Agreement for Complete Subsidiary Status of Saikaya Department Store Co., Ltd. by AFC-HD Amus Life Science Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
AFC-HD Amus Life Science Co., Ltd. and Saikaya Department Store Co., Ltd. executed a stock exchange agreement on October 16, 2026, under which AFC-HD will become the complete parent company and Saikaya will become the wholly owned subsidiary. The stock exchange will take effect on December 15, 2026, after which Saikaya shares will delist from the Tokyo Stock Exchange (scheduled for December 11, 2026). Saikaya's shareholders will vote on the agreement at the ordinary general meeting scheduled for November 16, 2026, while AFC-HD will not hold a shareholder meeting as this qualifies as a simplified stock exchange under the Companies Act.

Both companies determined the exchange ratio by comprehensively considering Saikaya's enterprise value based on independent valuation, earnings capacity, financial condition, asset value of real estate holdings (including the Yokosuka and Fujisawa stores), future business risks, and market stock price. The transaction aims to achieve integrated management of group resources, faster decision-making, improved operational efficiency, and strengthened financial foundation. Following completion, AFC-HD will leverage Saikaya's real estate and other assets while maintaining and reinforcing its department store operations and exploring future business structure and real estate utilization opportunities.
